name: Z Poker
description: Z Poker is a little-known community card poker variant with 4 community cards instead of 5. Players get 2 hole cards and use a modified community card structure. Home game variant — unlikely found in casinos.

overview.description: Z Poker is a little-known community card poker variant with 4 community cards instead of 5. Players get 2 hole cards and use a modified community card structure. Home game variant — unlikely found in casinos.

history.origins: Poker variants were largely created in the United States from the mid-1800s through the early 1900s. Z Poker belongs to the community card poker family, in which each player's hidden hand is combined with shared face-up cards; it is typically played in home games, often as part of dealer's choice, and uses four community cards instead of the usual five.
timeline: 20th century: home poker variant with 4 community cards; documented in US.

setup.deck: One standard 52-card French deck; no jokers. Same deck as Texas hold'em and other community card games.

rules.objective: Win the pot by making the best 5-card poker hand using your 2 hole cards and the 4 community cards.
rules.gameplay: 2 hole cards. 4 community cards dealt in stages. Betting rounds. Showdown: best 5-card hand using hole + community cards.
